title: Maximum scan of one literal
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean word containing the serialization of the literal $(v,\mathrm{pol})$ between a prefix and suffix, where $v\in\mathbb{N}$ and $\mathrm{pol}$ is a Boolean polarity. For every counter length $n$, second-tape content, second-tape head position $b$, and output word $o$, starting in state $3$ with the counter head at $0$, after exactly $2v+5$ steps the machine is again in state $3$, at the input position just after the literal, with counter length $\max(n,v+1)$ and counter head at $0$; the second tape, its head, and the output are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: input decomposition containing the serialized literal
replaced:
Suppose the input contains a serialized literal $(v,\mathrm{pol})$ at the current
position and the transducer is in its clause-level maximum state with counter
length $n$ and counter head at $0$. Then exactly $2v + 5$ transitions consume the
literal, record the counter length $\max(n,\, v + 1)$, restore the counter head to
$0$, and return to the same state with the input advanced by $v + 3$.
